CREATE TABLE lake.bronze.customer WITH (format='PARQUET',compression_codec='ZSTD') AS SELECT * FROM tpch.sf1.customer
CREATE TABLE lake.bronze.orders WITH (format='PARQUET',compression_codec='ZSTD') AS SELECT * FROM tpch.sf1.orders
CREATE TABLE lake.bronze.lineitem WITH (format='PARQUET',compression_codec='ZSTD') AS SELECT * FROM tpch.sf1.lineitem
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT custkey FROM lake.bronze.customer GROUP BY custkey HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT orderkey FROM lake.bronze.orders GROUP BY orderkey HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT orderkey,linenumber FROM lake.bronze.lineitem GROUP BY orderkey,linenumber HAVING count(*)>1)

CREATE TABLE lake.silver.customer WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT custkey, trim(name) AS name FROM lake.bronze.customer
WHERE custkey IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE lake.silver.orders WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, custkey, CAST(orderdate AS date) AS orderdate,
       CAST(totalprice AS decimal(15,2)) AS totalprice
FROM lake.bronze.orders
WHERE orderkey IS NOT NULL AND custkey IS NOT NULL
  AND orderdate IS NOT NULL AND totalprice >= 0

CREATE TABLE lake.silver.lineitem WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, linenumber, CAST(quantity AS decimal(15,2)) AS quantity
FROM lake.bronze.lineitem
WHERE orderkey IS NOT NULL AND linenumber IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0

CREATE TABLE lake.silver.large_orders WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, sum(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM lake.silver.lineitem
GROUP BY orderkey HAVING sum(quantity) > 300

CREATE TABLE lake.silver.customer_orders WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT c.name, c.custkey, o.orderkey, o.orderdate, o.totalprice, l.total_quantity
FROM lake.silver.large_orders l
JOIN lake.silver.orders o ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
JOIN lake.silver.customer c ON o.custkey = c.custkey

CREATE TABLE lake.gold.q18_top100 WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT name, custkey, orderkey, orderdate, totalprice, total_quantity
FROM lake.silver.customer_orders
ORDER BY totalprice DESC, orderdate, orderkey LIMIT 100
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lake.bronze.customer)-(SELECT count(*) FROM lake.silver.customer)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lake.bronze.orders)-(SELECT count(*) FROM lake.silver.orders)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lake.bronze.lineitem)-(SELECT count(*) FROM lake.silver.lineitem)
SELECT count(*) FROM lake.silver.orders o LEFT JOIN lake.silver.customer c ON o.custkey=c.custkey WHERE c.custkey IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM lake.silver.lineitem l LEFT JOIN lake.silver.orders o ON l.orderkey=o.orderkey WHERE o.orderkey IS NULL
SELECT * FROM lake.gold.q18_top100 ORDER BY totalprice DESC,orderdate,orderkey
